wallBasicBody: I-akhawunti yemahhala ifaka kusesha la-10 ngelilanga. Umkhawulo ucala kabusha kusasa, nobe uzame i-Individual kute utfole kusesha ngaphandle kwemkhawulo, titfombe nawo onkhe ematfuluzi ekufundza.
sayPaidBody: Kusho kuyincenye yemahlelo e-Individual, Family ne-Schools.
famSingleChild: Kunemfundzi munye nje ekhaya? I-Individual ingu-{price} ngenyanga. Ngekwengeta kancane, i-Family ifaka bantfwana labafika ku-5.
featFamPeople: Umntfwana ngamunye utfola onkhe ematfuluzi, ngeSimo sebantfwana. Umtali ukhokha kanye kuphela ngemndeni wonkhe.
demoPlusMore: Futsi lokunye: emakhwizi, imidlalo nemidlalo yemagama yebabili
partnersCalcNote: Lesilinganiso sisekelwe elihlelweni le-Individual nesilinganiso sa-25%. Emakhasimende lakhokha ngemnyaka, e-Family ne-Schools ayasikhuphula.
helpSwitchA1: Vula likhasi lakho le-Akhawunti bese ucindzetela "Shintjela ku-Family". Kubhalisa kwakho kwanyalo kuvuselelwa ngelikhadi lelifanako, ngaphandle kwekulifaka futsi.
helpSwitchA2: I-Stripe ibala umehluko wemalanga lasele esikhatsini sanyalo, ngako ukhokha umehluko kuphela.
helpChargeA1: Tinkhokhelo tivela njenge-GADIT nobe GADIT.APP. I-Individual ingu-$3.99 ngenyanga nobe $39.99 ngemnyaka, kantsi i-Family ingu-$5.99 ngenyanga nobe $59 ngemnyaka. E-Israel inkhokhelo yenteka ngemashekeli: ₪14.90 nobe ₪149 ye-Individual, ₪19.90 nobe ₪199 ye-Family. Kubhalisa kwangaphambi kwa-Okthoba 2026 kugcina linani lekwacala ngalo. Nangabe linani alifani, kungenteka livela kulenye insita.
helpCompareQ: Uyini umehluko emkhatsini we-Basic, Individual ne-Family?
helpCompareA1: Basic (mahhala): kufika kusesha emagama la-10 ngelilanga, tonkhe tinchazelo, tibonelo, Tisho netinkhulumo, Imvelaphi yeligama kanye ne-Incwadzi lefika emagameni langu-30.
helpCompareA2: Individual ($3.99 a month or $39.99 a year, ₪14.90 or ₪149 in Israel): umuntfu munye, onkhe emathulusi. Kusesha lokungapheli, sitfombe sayo yonkhe inchazelo, inchazelo lefanele esivakalweni, Every Word, Say it, bhala sivakaliso ngemibono, imisho yesibonelo lengetiwe nemibuto ngeligama ngalinye, livi lemvelo lekufundza ngekuphimisela, kusebentisa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, imidlalo, emakhwizi nemidlalo yemagama yebabili, nekutiniketa lokuhlakaniphile nekuhlanganyela nekulungiselela sivivinyo neidikiteshini.
helpCompareA3: Family ($5.99 ngenyanga nobe $59 ngemnyaka, ₪19.90 nobe ₪199 e-Israel): konkhe lokuku-Individual kwebantfwana labafika ku-5 nebatali bobabili, kanye neSimo sebantfwana, indzawo yakhe yemntfwana ngamunye, libhodi lemtali lelinetatiso temagama, kanye neKupela.

remBody:
Sawubona {name},

Kulinga kwakho kwamahhala kwe-Gadit kuphela nga-{date}.

## Kutawentekani ngemuva kwaloko
Ngalelo langa likhadi lakho litawukhokhiswa {amount} {cycle} nge-{plan}.

Akudzingeki kutsi wente lutfo kute uchubeke.

## Indlela yekukhansela
Ungakhansela nobe nini ngaphambi kwa-{date}, futsi ngeke ukhokhiswe lutfo.

1. Vula [likhasi lakho le-akhawunti](/account).
2. Cindzetela "Phatsa tinkhokhelo".
3. Elikhasini lelivulekako, khetsa kukhansela kubhalisa.
pupBody:
Sawubona {name},

Siyabonga ngekusebentisa i-Gadit ku-Android.

I-akhawunti yakho nyalo ikulihlelo le-Basic.

Ungatfola onkhe ematfuluzi ngemahlelo e-Individual ne-Family.

## Family

Yebatali nebantfwana.

Kufika ebantfwaneni labangu-5, ngamunye anencwadzi yakhe, Simo sebantfwana nelibhodi lemtali.

## Individual

Yemuntfu munye.

Kusesha ngaphandle kwemkhawulo nawo onkhe ematfuluzi.

Wombili acala ngemalanga langu-14 mahhala.

Ungakhansela nobe nini ngaphambi kwekutsi kuphele kulinga, futsi ngeke ukhokhiswe lutfo.

Nawubhalisile, i-app itawutivuselela yona.

Vele ungene nge-akhawunti lefanako.
